title: Contacts
description: The contacts of the settings — numbers, e-mails, addresses, hours, networks — and a form of the Inbox beside them, if one is named.

schema.label: Contacts of the settings
schema.help: Numbers, e-mails, addresses and networks from Settings › Contacts.

schema.label: Form
schema.help: A form of the Inbox, printed beside the contacts. Empty: no form.

schema.label: Description of the form
schema.help: The line under the form's title, as its dialog prints it. Off: the headings of the block say what the form is for.
